meta.title: Ragyo — UTAU / OpenUTAU Voice Library
meta.description: Ragyo is a VCV UTAU / OpenUTAU voice library covering C1–B7 across three pitches plus a Soft tone. Samples, terms of use and downloads.

hero.tagline: Ink-blue fur, red eyes — a wolf's voice at the microphone.

about.title: The Library
about.lead: Ragyo is a VCV voice library for UTAU. Each of the three pitches is recorded in both a normal and a Soft tone, covering C1 through B7.
about.subbanksLead: These correspond to the subbanks defined in character.yaml. Each pitch is recorded in both a normal and a Soft tone so you can pick per phrase.
about.enginesNote: OpenUTAU reads the subbanks declared in character.yaml directly, so pitches and the Soft tone can be switched from inside the software.
about.sourceNote: ※ Library details on this page are taken from the character.yaml and character.txt files bundled with the release.

character.title: Character
character.lead: Ragyo — a wolf with ink-blue fur and red eyes, wearing a black headset and a microphone boom.
designNotes: Beneath the left side of both eyes there is fur shaped like (＞UWU＜), and a medium-length small braid sits at the back of the head. This is a key design point.
Both outfits included in the release are official costumes for Ragyo. Feel free to use them in your videos.
Ragyo's fur colour is “ink-like blue”. You may adjust the tone based on this impression.
In derivative works you are free to change Ragyo's outfit as you like.
character.galleryNote: Ragyo's illustrations may be freely used for non-profit derivative works. See the terms of use for the full conditions.

download.title: Download
download.lead: Ragyo's voicebank and illustrations are distributed through the cloud storage services below.
download.overseasHint: Baidu Netdisk and Quark Drive primarily serve mainland China. Outside China, please use Google Drive.
download.pendingBody: The download links are being prepared. Please check back once the release is public.
download.feedback: If a link does not open, please contact the author.
installSteps: Use Tools → Install Singer to install the voicebank. rar, zip and uar archives are supported, and you can also drag an archive into the OpenUTAU window.
The installer previews the wav filenames and oto.ini inside the archive. If the text is garbled, choose the correct text encoding in the top-right corner.

Note: on non-Japanese systems, do not extract the archive manually — always install it via Install Singer. Once installed, "Ragyo" appears in the singer list with all three pitches and the Soft tone ready to use.
installStepsUtau: Place the extracted folder into UTAU's voice directory.
Keep the folder name in single-byte alphanumeric characters; do not rename it.
